audit.description: Changed production code in pastepwn/util/request.py imports the real aiohttp package and meaningfully uses aiohttp helpers, ClientTimeout, TCPConnector, ClientSession, and session.request. The diff removes direct requests usage from the changed production files, including replacing requests.packages.urllib3.util.connection with urllib3.util.connection in pastepwn/util/network.py. Dynamic evidence reports no source imports from production repo code, while target aiohttp events originate from site-packages/aiohttp rather than a local provider.
evidence: pastepwn/util/request.py: adds import aiohttp and uses aiohttp.helpers.proxies_from_env(), aiohttp.ClientTimeout, aiohttp.TCPConnector, aiohttp.ClientSession, and session.request(...)
pastepwn/util/request.py: removes from requests import Session, utils and from requests.exceptions import Timeout
pastepwn/util/network.py: replaces import requests.packages.urllib3.util.connection as urllib3_cn with import urllib3.util.connection as urllib3_cn
dynamic metrics: target_events_from_production_repo_count=15 with first target import from pastepwn/util/request.py and origin site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py
reasons: aiohttp is imported and used in changed production code
requests direct production-code usage was removed from changed files
dynamic source imports are only from dependencies, not repo production code
no local fake aiohttp provider was detected

+        if isinstance(self.proxies, str):

     def _request_wrapper(self, data, timeout, *args, **kwargs):
